title: Tailoring the electrolyte/electrode interface with 18-crown-6 and fluoroethylene carbonate for controlled and uniform lithium deposition
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00848D, Paper
Bo zhang, Liguang Qin, Jiaqing Tang, Minghe Zhu, Shiyu Hua, Qinyang Xue, Yunzeng Cui, Shangqi Sun, Chang Guo
We report 18-crown-6 as an effective additive for smooth LMB deposition. In combination with FEC, it promotes a LiF-rich SEI, enhancing interface stability and enabling dense, uniform lithium growth.
